layouts.why: three short labels share a row
a label of 11–18 characters lets the row hold two
a medium label first keeps the row to two for the short ones after it
a label of 19 characters or more has a row of its own
a narrower card, two a row
a destructive command is danger, the first other run the primary, an Open a row of its own
runs of one command side by side are a choice
four runs of one command are buttons
a choice must fit one row
a narrower card takes a choice of two, not of three
a destructive command is never a choice
a Publish is the owner's panel, in no row

rules: 22-grain-chats §5a; the reference is saltix_types::grain::chat::card
a label's length is its count of Unicode scalar values: at most 10 lets three share a row, at most 18 two, longer one
a row takes the next button while its length + 1 is within every label's allowance in it and per_row; a choice and an Open each take a row; a Publish takes none
per_row: 3 for a card at least 320 dp wide, 2 at least 220 dp, else 1

emphasis: a Run whose command (or its part before the first _) is destructive is danger; a whole run of 2–3 consecutive Runs of one non-destructive command whose labels all allow that many in a row and per_row allows is a choice; the first other Run is the primary; other Runs and Replies secondary; Open app; Publish owner
a poll is segmented when open, without a tally, at most 3 options of at most 12 characters; else a list
shares: floors of votes × 100 / total, the points left to the largest remainders (an earlier option first among equal ones); all 0 without votes
a field's value is a token (monospace with Copy) when it has at least 20 characters and no whitespace
a File whose format is png, jpg, jpeg, gif or webp previews as an image

refused.change: member signed by the owner key
refused.why: a bad proof: signed by a key that does not speak for the account (Member Signer)
a proof for another grain key (Member Mismatch)
in a language out of form: no reader takes it
an account off the team: a user only (Member NotTeam)
relayed from another address than its key's (Sender)

refused.change: a second hello of the same key, id 16…16, within an hour of the welcome
refused.why: past the rate: taken, the address kept, no welcome

refused.change: the wallet's hello in flight is 16…16

refused.why: an option's arguments out of order
a command that is no name
a duration the command does not offer
relayed from another address than its key's
a price above 0 in this version
a server key signed a spec with a price
a registered key the owner removed
a private grain's request without a member proof
a member proof for another grain key
a member proof longer than 30 days
an account that is no longer a member
a language neither empty nor 2–8 of [a-z-]: no reader takes it

rules: GrainChatSpec is signed by the manifest's owner_key over derive-domain "Saltix grain chat spec v1" of its Borsh (no genesis hash)
ChatRequest is signed by the user's grain key over derive-domain "Saltix grain chat request v1" of genesis_hash ‖ Borsh(request)

SignedGrainChatSpec is Borsh {spec, server: Option<[u8;32]>, signature}: server none, the owner key signed; a key, a server key the grain's registry record names signed, and then every command's price is 0 (24-app-studio §2)

ChatMessage is signed by the server key over derive-domain "Saltix grain chat message v1" of genesis_hash ‖ Borsh(message); SignedChatMessage is Borsh {message, server: ServerKey, signature}, ServerKey = 0 Certified(InvoiceKeyCert) | 1 Registered([u8;32]); a certificate (12-grains §5.2) is signed by the owner key and ends at most 31 days ahead; a registered key is one the grain's registry record names at the wallet's canonical beacon block (registered_servers); either key is not in the spec's `revoked`

ChatRequest has member: Option<SignedMemberProof> after text; SignedMemberProof is Borsh {proof: MemberProof {slug, account [32], grain_key [32], expires_at u64 ms}, key: DeviceKey (Ed25519 tag 0 [32] | P256 tag 1 [33]), signature [64]}; the key speaks for the account and signs derive-domain "Saltix grain member v1" of genesis_hash ‖ Borsh(proof); a private grain's server takes a request only with a proof for its slug and the request's key, alive, at most 30 days ahead, from its owner or a member with role user (1) or developer (2)

ChatRequest ends with lang: String after member: the language the user's Saltix shows, 2–8 of [a-z-] as maps name languages, or empty when the app does not say; a reader refuses a request with any other lang, as it refuses bytes that are not canonical (request: "ru", text_request: "")

GrainStats {slug, at u64 ms, users_1d u32, users_30d u32, requests_30d u64} is signed by a registered server key over derive-domain "Saltix grain stats v1" of genesis_hash ‖ Borsh(stats); SignedGrainStats is Borsh {stats, key [32], signature}; a wallet shows it at most 2 days old, with users_1d ≤ users_30d ≤ requests_30d
a frame's plaintext is the 4 bytes "SGC1" then Borsh(ChatFrame): 0 Request, 1 Message, 2 Spec {spec, cert: Option<InvoiceKeyCert>}, 3 Stats(SignedGrainStats); at most 48 000 bytes
a request comes from its key's personal address, a message from its cert key's; requests live at most 7 days; messages are shown at most 30 days old and 5 minutes ahead
a request's args are sorted by name, each a parameter of its command, every required one present, each of its kind and among its options

FileRef: Borsh {relay: Option<String>, id, key [32], iv [12], hash [32] SHA-256 of the plaintext, size u64, name, mime}; JSON {cmd: file_ref, id, key and iv in standard base64, hash hex, size, name, mime, relay?}

ChatHello {slug, id [16], at u64 ms, member: SignedMemberProof, lang} is signed by the user's grain key over derive-domain "Saltix grain chat hello v1" of genesis_hash ‖ Borsh(hello); SignedChatHello is Borsh {hello, key [32], signature}; frame tag 4, user to server only (22-grain-chats §3a). A server takes it from its key's personal address, for its slug, dated at most 5 minutes ahead and at most 7 days behind, with a proof that checks as a request's and an account on the grain's team (owner, developer 2 or viewer 4; a user 1 is not); it keeps the address and welcomes a key at most once an hour; anything else gets no answer

ChatWelcome {slug, hello [16]: the hello's id, at u64 ms} is signed by the server key over derive-domain "Saltix grain chat welcome v1" of genesis_hash ‖ Borsh(welcome); SignedChatWelcome is Borsh {welcome, server: ServerKey, signature}; frame tag 5, server to user only; a wallet takes it from the server key's address, for the hello in flight, at most 5 minutes ahead

ActionKind = 0 Run {command, args} | 1 Open {start} | 2 Reply {text} | 3 Publish {manifest: String}: the <manifest> of salt:grain-publish?m=<manifest> (12-grains §10), 1–2 027 characters of canonical base64url without padding of one raw DEFLATE stream (nothing after its last block) inflating to at most 16 384 bytes, the canonical Borsh of a GrainManifest whose owner is 32 zero bytes and owner_key Ed25519 32 zero bytes, its slug the message's; at most one Publish a message; otherwise the message is refused whole (another grain's slug: Slug); a wallet shows it only to an account on the grain's team, the button in its own words; readers that predate tag 3 refuse the frame

Block = 0 Text {text} | 1 Fields {rows} | 2 Secret {label, value, expires_at} | 3 File {file, title, format} | 4 Invoice {invoice} | 5 Status {state, text} | 6 Code {text: 1–4 000 characters, line breaks kept} | 7 Poll {question: 1–200 characters, command: a command's name, options: Vec<PollOption {label: 1–60 characters, args: sorted by name, votes: u32}> (2–10), chosen: Option<u8> below the options' count, closed: bool, tally: bool}; a tap on an option sends command with its args via the message, as a Run; readers that predate tags 6 and 7 refuse the frame (Saltix 0.1.53 and older)
